assertions.text: Creates only the canonical strategy artifact
assertions.script: DIR=testspec/changes/synthetic-wallet-dashboard && test -f "$DIR/strategy.md" && test ! -f "$DIR/specs/testpoints.md" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Defines the required strategy sections and traceability
assertions.script: FILE=testspec/changes/synthetic-wallet-dashboard/strategy.md && grep -q 'Oracle Catalog' "$FILE" && grep -q 'Environment Matrix' "$FILE" && grep -q 'Capability Matrix' "$FILE" && grep -q 'Inconclusive' "$FILE" && grep -q 'REQ-001' "$FILE" && grep -q 'RISK-001' "$FILE" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Preserves context schema v2 and revision 2 through plan
Uses the fewest sufficient seams rather than demanding one seam
